pages.text: Out past the edge of the sky, round a black hole feeding on a disk of its own fire, islands of rock and ice drift in the dark. The $(thing)Accretion Frontier$() is reached with a $(item)Light Sail$() (research $(thing)Galactic Dynamics$()): climb to y 200 or higher, stand under open sky, and unfurl it. Unfurled again in the Frontier, it brings you home and slows your fall.

It has five regions. The $(thing)Molecular Cloud Nebula$(), cold ice and dust where stars are born: you cannot see far. The $(thing)Asteroid Belt$(), where you weigh almost nothing - and $(thing)micrometeorites$() strike anyone not wearing a $(item)Whipple Shield$() (a quarter stopped per piece; a full set stops all).

The $(thing)Pulsar Field$(): crust of neutron-star iron, and a pulse of radiation every five seconds, on the beat, for anyone under open sky. Gravity is high and time runs slow (Time Dilation). The $(thing)Accretion Rim$(): slag lakes of disk plasma; it is hot enough to burn, and the disk's tidal pull stretches you. The $(thing)Lensing Void$(): black glass, sight lines bent, and frame-dragging currents that push you sideways.

Its ores: $(item)Interstellar Dust$() in the nebula's ice, $(item)Exoplanet Core Samples$() and $(item)Brown Dwarf Cores$() in the asteroids, $(item)Magnetar Crust$(), $(item)Pulsar Timing Crystals$() and $(item)Cosmic Ray Shards$() in the pulsar crust, $(item)Accretion Disk Fragments$() in the slag, and $(item)Einstein Ring Lenses$() in the void glass. Derelict Stations drift between the islands; Pulsar Beacons stand on the field.
